profile_md:
**Cardiff** has employer-linked group project provision concentrated in **computing** and the **Business School** (mostly postgraduate). No university-wide route was verified.

- **Clearest current route:** the **National Software Academy**'s BSc Applied Software Engineering builds team client projects into the degree. Teams build software for real private, public and third-sector clients over projects of about four weeks, meeting clients fortnightly (2026-entry page).
- **Business School:**
  - The **MSc Strategic Entrepreneurship and Innovation New Venture Plan** (BST413, 40 credits; optional instead of a dissertation) assigns each group a real company client that sets the brief.
  - The **MBA Management Consultancy elective**, co-run with PA Consulting, sends teams to Welsh charities (e.g. Tenovus Cancer Care, WCVA).
  - The current status of both is undated.
  - The **MBA live/Accelerator project** (corporate client) and the **MSc Business Management Consultancy Challenge** (charity clients only 'may') are incomplete on group work or external coverage.
- **Planning:** MSc Spatial Planning **Live Project** CPT831 has real clients such as planning authorities (group work unconfirmed). An older UG group consultancy module (CP0210) is evidenced only for 2016/17.
- **Architecture:** live projects with Grangetown community clients (Grange Pavilion) and MArch Design in Practice. Group structure and current status are unclear.
- **Excluded or unverified:**
  - The legacy **Bremen-Cardiff** sustainability programme (two weeks, real-world problem) has no evidenced external client.
  - The **Cardiff Award** is an employability framework.
  - **Law pro bono** is volunteer casework.
- **Uncertain:** this review is **Partial**. Health schools, Journalism, Social Sciences and central enterprise challenges were not searched, and most Business School pages are undated.
gaps: Review is Partial (see partial_remaining). Key gaps: health schools not searched; science covered by one search only; group structure for MBA live project, MSc SPD Live Project and architecture live projects; whether MSc Business Management Consultancy Challenge always has an external client; dated 2025/26 evidence for Business School routes; whether engineering MSc group projects routinely have company partners and on which programmes; Bremen-Cardiff eligibility and any external problem owner; Student Enterprise annual report content; FinTech Wales Skills Challenge and Public Value Hackathon format. Further departmental instances are likely (e.g. NSA MSc Software Engineering, Computer Science MSc, Journalism). Reduced-depth round: WebFetch returned 403 for cardiff.ac.uk so no page text was obtained; health schools and Journalism remain unverified after one search.
